_note: Joint channels (frank/engine/channels.py) to eye-board servos. Sides are Frank's own (L = his left). The lid sockets follow firmware/eye_anim.py (TOP_LIDS CUR, CLR = top lid of the eye on your right, on your left, seen from the front) and the brow sockets follow brow_anim.py's bench layout (JL left outer, JR right outer, LUL left inner, LUR right inner, seen from the front), so viewer's left = Frank's right. CHECK ON THE HEAD: 'curious' must raise both brows, 'skeptical' must raise Frank's LEFT brow (the viewer's right); a lid_asym > 0 must narrow Frank's LEFT eye. If a pair is the wrong way round, set swap_brow_sides or swap_lid_sides to true. If a brow end goes down when it should rise, flip its dir. If the eyes look the wrong way, flip gaze_x_sign or UD_UP.
